FX-STROKE-001.says: Mask 1, a box from (2, 2) to (13, 7) of mode None, stroked with the defaults but Brush Size 3: a white line 3 pixels wide all round the box, over the night sky and the empty half, Hardness 75, Spacing 15, Start 0, End 100, On Original Image.

FX-STROKE-002.says: End 50: from the top-left corner along the top and down the right side, half the box's 32 pixels.

FX-STROKE-003.says: Start 25, End 75: from 8 pixels along to 24.

FX-STROKE-004.says: Start 75, End 25: taken smaller first, FX-STROKE-003's frame.

FX-STROKE-005.says: Start 40, End 40: nothing is drawn; the drawing, untouched.

FX-STROKE-006.says: Spacing 100, Hardness 0: round dabs a brush apart, each soft, a string of beads.

FX-STROKE-007.says: Spacing 0: the brush laid all along, a smooth line.

FX-STROKE-008.says: Hardness 0: soft from its middle out.

FX-STROKE-009.says: Hardness 100: hard, smoothed over one pixel.

FX-STROKE-013.says: On Transparent: the stroke alone, the night sky gone.

FX-STROKE-014.says: Reveal Original Image: the night sky only under the stroke, the colour unused.

FX-STROKE-015.says: Brush Size 0: nothing is drawn; the drawing, untouched.

FX-STROKE-016.says: Brush Size 0, On Transparent: nothing at all.

FX-STROKE-017.says: Two masks, the box and a small box from (5, 4) to (9, 6), Path mask 2: the small box alone.

FX-STROKE-018.says: Two masks, All Masks on: both.

FX-STROKE-019.says: Two masks, All Masks on, End 50: each mask's own first half.

FX-STROKE-020.says: Two masks, All Masks and Stroke Sequentially on, End keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the box draws on, then the small box, as one 44-pixel path; frame 0 nothing, frame 2 22 pixels of the box, frame 3 the box and 1 pixel of the small box, frame 4 both.

FX-STROKE-021.says: Stroke Sequentially on with All Masks off: the one mask, FX-STROKE-002's frame.

FX-STROKE-022.says: A curved mask, a circle 8 across about (8, 5): the stroke follows the curve.

FX-STROKE-023.says: Start keyed from 0 to 50 and End from 50 to 100, frames 0 to 4: half the box travels round it, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-STROKE-024.says: The mask's path keyed from the box at frame 0 to the box two rows lower at frame 4: the stroke follows it, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-STROKE-025.says: End keyed from 4 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 100, is held at 100, and is End 100.

FX-STROKE-026.says: FX-STROKE-001 moved three pixels right: the stroke moves with the drawing.

FX-STROKE-027.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the mask is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-STROKE-001's.

FX-STROKE-028.says: The box's mask of mode Add: the drawing is cut to the box first, then stroked, the stroke's outer half over nothing.

FX-STROKE-029.says: Two masks, the first switched off, All Masks on: the small box alone.

FX-STROKE-030.says: Path mask 1.5: its floor, mask 1, FX-STROKE-001's frame.

FX-STROKE-031.says: No masks at all. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-STROKE-032.says: Path mask 3, of two. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-STROKE-033.says: Path mask 1, switched off. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-STROKE-034.says: All Masks on, every mask switched off. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-STROKE-035.says: Brush Size 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-036.says: Brush Hardness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-037.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-038.says: Start -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-039.says: End 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-040.says: Spacing 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-041.says: Path mask 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-042.says: A colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-043.says: Paint Style "paint", which is not "on_original", "on_transparent" or "reveal". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-044.says: All Masks "yes", which is not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-045.says: Stroke Sequentially "maybe", which is not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROKE-046.says: End keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
